dct_description_sm: This study examines both Canadian and American opinions of their respective Supreme Courts. There are 2 datasets for this study: one asking Canadians about the Supreme Court of Canada and one asking Americans about the Supreme Court of the United States.
dct_title_s: Supreme Court of the United States and the Supreme Court of Canada, 2015
